title: Ocean, which uses AI agents to detect email attacks, raised a $20M Series A led by Lightspeed, following an $8M seed in 2024 (Meir Orbach/CTech)
summary: Meir Orbach / CTech: Ocean, which uses AI agents to detect email attacks, raised a $20M Series A led by Lightspeed, following an $8M seed in 2024 — The cybersecurity startup says its platform replaces legacy phishing defenses with AI agents that analyze intent, not just patterns.
